svg.title: HaxMind: Internal AI assistant
svg.desc: One chat interface over internal SOPs and live data from five business tools, replacing manual lookups across all of them. Stack: RAG, LLM agents, MCP, pgvector, Supabase, Asana API. Built the assistant. System: Internal SOPs, Maqsam calls, Fathom transcripts, GoHighLevel (MCP), Asana, Employee records into RAG agent (pgvector + LLM), out to Chat answers.
